scripts.test:e2e: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$exitCode = 1; $p = Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList './node_modules/next/dist/bin/next','dev' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; try { $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120; $i++) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 500) { $ready = $true; break } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if (-not $ready) { Write-Error 'Next dev server did not become ready'; $exitCode = 1 } else { $env:PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER = '1'; npx playwright test; $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { taskkill /pid $p.Id /T /F 2>$null | Out-Null }; exit $exitCode"
